current_deployments_yaml:
# Current (old) Deployments, as they run before the rollout. Namespace + name
# pair each one with the Deployment rendered from the new chart.
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: rollout-demo-api
  namespace: rollout-demo
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: rollout-demo
      app.kubernetes.io/component: api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: rollout-demo
        app.kubernetes.io/component: api
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: api
          image: registry.local/rollout-demo/api:1.0.0
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 50m
              memory: 64Mi
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: rollout-demo-worker
  namespace: rollout-demo
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: rollout-demo
      app.kubernetes.io/component: worker
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: rollout-demo
        app.kubernetes.io/component: worker
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: worker
          image: registry.local/rollout-demo/worker:1.0.0
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 50m
              memory: 64Mi
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: rollout-demo-report
  namespace: rollout-demo
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: rollout-demo
      app.kubernetes.io/component: report
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: rollout-demo
        app.kubernetes.io/component: report
    spec:
      initContainers:
        - name: prepare
          image: registry.local/rollout-demo/report-prepare:1.0.0
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 128Mi
      containers:
        - name: report
          image: registry.local/rollout-demo/report:1.0.0
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 50m
              memory: 64Mi
---
